NAME: I2C master verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-I2C-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 Master write and read transfers to a 7-bit addressed slave with ...
details: Master write and read transfers to a 7-bit addressed slave, with repeated start.
implementation_note: Source: SYS §6.4

NAME: t_i2c_write
details: Oracle: the slave model records address, register and data
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, checks tagged [R-1] (address acknowledged, 0xA5 stored at register 0x10, one START and one STOP, no SDA change while SCL high) and [N-7.1] - 5 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_i2c_read
details: Oracle: the DUT returns what the model was preloaded with
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, checks [R-1] read back 0x3C, [R-1] [N-6.4] RXVALID cleared by the read, [N-6.4] no second transfer - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_i2c_repeated_start
details: Oracle: a register read with repeated start, no STOP between
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, check [R-1] two STARTs, one STOP - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_i2c_burst
details: Oracle: 8-byte read, ACK on all but the last
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, checks [R-1] 8-byte burst read and [N-6.2a] ACK on bytes 0..6, NACK on the last - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-2 SCL at or below 100 kHz and 400 kHz from pclk = 125 MHz.
details: SCL at or below 100 kHz and 400 kHz from pclk = 125 MHz.

NAME: t_i2c_scl_rate
details: Oracle: measured SCL at PRESCALE 249 and 61, against the mode limit
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, checks tagged [R-2] (94.5 kHz at PRESCALE 249, 373.1 kHz at PRESCALE 61) - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-3 Word-only APB 32-bit registers at word-aligned offsets.
details: Word-only APB, 32-bit registers at word-aligned offsets.
implementation_note: Source: AHB2APB [N-7.12]

NAME: t_i2c_regs
details: Oracle: every register reads back; PSLVERR on unmapped and on CMD while TIP
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, checks tagged [R-3], the ID read, [N-6.2] CMD reads 0 and [N-6.2b] PSLVERR on CMD while TIP - 7 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-4 Never stall the APB bus.
details: Never stall the APB bus.
implementation_note: Source: AHB2APB [N-7.15]

NAME: t_i2c_pready
details: Oracle: PREADY high in every cycle of every access
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, check [R-4] PREADY high in every cycle of every access - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-5 One held level interrupt to CLIC ID 16.
details: One held, level interrupt to CLIC ID 16.
implementation_note: Source: CLIC §7.2, D-17

NAME: t_i2c_irq
details: Oracle: held ≥50 pclk, drops only on W1C
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, checks tagged [R-5] (asserted, still asserted 60 pclk later, W1C clears it) - 5 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-6 DMA request acknowledge on channel 1 one beat per assertion.
details: DMA request/acknowledge on channel 1, one beat per assertion.
implementation_note: Source: DMA §7.3, D-21

NAME: t_i2c_dma
details: Oracle: dma_req_checker; request drops after ack
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, checks tagged [R-6] (with dma_req_checker) and [N-7.7] - 11 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-7 Report a NACK and arbitration loss without hanging.
details: Report a NACK, and arbitration loss, without hanging.
implementation_note: Source: UM10204 §3.1.6

NAME: t_i2c_nack
details: Oracle: an unaddressed slave leaves RXNACK set and IRQSTAT[3]
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, checks tagged [R-7] (unanswered address and refused data byte set RXNACK and IRQSTAT[3], STOP still sent) - 8 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-8 A wedged slave must not hang the SoC a transfer that stalls is ...
details: A wedged slave must not hang the SoC: a transfer that stalls is abandoned and the bus released.
implementation_note: Source: Board safety

NAME: t_i2c_stretch
details: Oracle: a slave that stretches past the timeout is abandoned, pins released, IRQSTAT[2]
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, checks tagged [R-8] for the timeout (STATUS.TIMEOUT, IRQSTAT[2], pins released, TIP cleared, block recovers) and [N-7.5a] - 7 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_i2c_stretch_ok
details: Oracle: a slave that stretches within the timeout completes normally
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, check [R-8] a slave stretching 20 us inside a 480 us budget completes - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-9 Open-drain discipline the block never drives either line high.
details: Open-drain discipline: the block never drives either line high.
implementation_note: Source: UM10204 §3.1.1

NAME: t_i2c_never_drives_high
details: Oracle: _o pins are 0 for the entire run
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, check [R-9] [N-9.2] the block never drove either line high (monitored for the whole run) - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-10 Pins released (inputs) from reset until firmware acts.
details: Pins released (inputs) from reset until firmware acts.
implementation_note: Source: Board safety

NAME: t_i2c_reset
details: Oracle: both _oe low out of reset
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/i2c/tb_i2c.sv, checks tagged [R-10] (lines released in and out of reset, bus idles high) - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: Added in the 2026-10-04 run
details: Checks added and defects found when the flow was run in order on 2026-10-04 (Docs/BUGS.md section 1h).

NAME: I2C-5 glitch-prone logic in the core reset
details: The vendored controller's asynchronous reset was a combinational function of the abort counter and could glitch and release mid-abort; found by HAL (GLTASR). The reset now comes from one flop.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_top.v. Covered by the [N-7.5] abort checks (36 phases); lint is clean on this rule.

NAME: I2C-6 disable mid-transfer left TIP set
details: CTRL.EN = 0 in the middle of a transfer left TIP and the command latched; firmware polling TIP hung and the next enable replayed the stale command onto the bus.
implementation_note: FIXED. Covered by [N-6.3] TIP clears when the block is disabled mid-transfer and [N-6.2] re-enabling does not replay the abandoned command; PASS.

NAME: Bench checks added
details: The bench grew from 42 to 88 checks, 90 with the APB checker (sim/tb_i2c/run.log: checks=90 FAIL=0): arbitration loss, abort in every phase, glitch filter, NACK generation, DMA request gating. Two more checks come from the APB protocol checker (tb/common/apb_checker.v) bound on this bench's config port on 2026-10-03.
